title: Best Habit Tracker app

author: Aminata Dossen

title: The best Habit Tracker App ever !
body:
Trust me I’ve tried a lot of Habit Trackers…This one is by far the best tracker Ive ever used. It provides Weekly, Monthly and Yearly Reports, it’s really easy to use and really aesthetic (themes, icon, colors..). You can choose when to start and how much time you’d like to keep your habit. You can add measurements for Water/Prayers Tracker etc..
You can build habits in groups and you have a overview of your streaks, best days, daily average. You also have a much more detailed reports of individual habits with graphics (weekly, monthly, yearly), about 6 records and yearly status. 
You must download this App trust me ! Ive been using it for 3 years now ❤️✨
author: Gemini_NM
